LANDING.HERO_SUBHEAD: A hybrid Learning Management System with integrated Anti-Cheating Engine.
LANDING.HERO_DESC: Experience absolute academic integrity with our native, zero-download proctoring solution combined with a premium learning experience.
LANDING.FEATURES_SUBTITLE: Built from the ground up to ensure fairness, security, and engagement.
LANDING.F1_DESC: Split screen detection, keyboard shortcut blocking, and real-time mouse monitoring.
LANDING.F2_DESC: Centralized question bank, dynamic randomization, secure tokens, and auto-grading.
LANDING.F3_DESC: Contextual chat support powered by Gemini API, fully integrated but locked during exams.
LANDING.F4_DESC: Seamless in-person tracking with live refreshing QR codes for secure, hardware-less check-ins.
LANDING.F5_DESC: Frictionless e-commerce gateway for course enrollments and subscription management.
LANDING.F6_DESC: Real-time visual analytics powered by ECharts for tracking student progress and instant violation alerts.
